Figures I've made for teaching, each with the code that draws it. Everything
here is in the public domain under
[CC0 1.0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/), so use and adapt
it however you like, with no need to ask or to credit me. Where a figure
redraws someone else's, its page credits the original; please keep that credit
when you reuse the figure.
